shared_elements: tall vertical block of weathered stone
shallow low-relief carving on a coarse, pitted surface
tapering or irregular outline at the base
justification: Both are tall, weathered stone monuments bearing shallow relief with framed rounded and scroll-like motifs, and both taper irregularly toward the base. But A is a three-dimensional carved figure whose sparse motifs follow the contours of a head, torso and folded arms, while B is a flat slab covered edge-to-edge with a dense, regular grid of rectangular blocks in columns — the organising logic of the two surfaces is fundamentally different.
